SELECT 
  m.category AS category,
  SUM(t.amount_idr) AS gmv
FROM 
  merchants m
JOIN 
  transactions t ON m.merchant_id = t.merchant_id
WHERE 
  t.created_at >= '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY 
  m.category

SELECT 
  method, 
  COUNT(*) AS success_count, 
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_rate
FROM 
  transactions
WHERE 
  created_at >= DATE '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY 
  method
SELECT T1.city, COUNT(*) FROM transactions AS T1 JOIN merchants AS T2 ON T1.merchant_id = T2.merchant_id WHERE T1.created_at >= '2026-09-30' GROUP BY T1.city
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND status = 'success'
SELECT AVG(amount_idr / amount_idr * 100) AS take_rate FROM transactions WHERE method = 'QRIS' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)

SELECT T1.name, SUM(T2.amount_idr) AS gmv
FROM merchants AS T1
JOIN transactions AS T2 ON T1.merchant_id = T2.merchant_id
WHERE T2.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY T1.merchant_id
ORDER BY gmv DESC
LIMIT 5
